pipeline.scope: sum of framework containers, including head/master and driver
pipeline.method: Docker stats samples; 100% CPU is one core; RAM excludes reclaimable cache as reported by Docker; observed peaks, not continuous maxima
pipeline.sampling: one-second pause between Docker stats calls; actual timestamps saved; calls add latency
